issues.issue: Can the Immigration Division consider pre-referral and investigative delay when ruling on abuse of process?
issues.applicant_position: ID may assess delay only from the date of the s.44(2) referral; pre-referral delay is for judicial review.
issues.respondent_position: ID can assess all abusive delay, including pre-referral and investigative delay, in its own proceedings.
issues.result_quote: The ID, like the RPD, has jurisdiction to grant a stay of proceedings where it finds an abuse of process by reason of delay

issues.issue: Did the Federal Court err in declining to hear the judicial review of the referral decision as premature?
issues.applicant_position: Referral judicial review is not premature; a stay may be sought at the earliest opportunity.
issues.respondent_position: Minister argued in the Federal Court that the review was premature; on appeal says the delay should have been assessed.
issues.result_quote: I see no palpable and overriding error in the Federal Court’s conclusion that the judicial review of the referral decision was premature

issues.issue: Should the fresh medical evidence on ongoing psychological harm from delay be admitted on appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Updated medical report showing continuing harm from the delay should be admitted.
issues.result_quote: I would accordingly dismiss the motion to admit it.

issues.issue: Should costs be awarded against the Minister for his change of position on appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Minister's shifted appellate position was unfair and caused avoidable litigation; costs should be awarded.
issues.result_quote: I would accordingly grant Mr. Rodas Tejeda his costs in both appeals

issues.issue: Should the style of cause be amended to name the Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness?
issues.applicant_position: Minister asks that the style of cause name the Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness.
issues.result_quote: the style of cause should be amended to reflect that the appropriate party in Court files A-72-25 and A-92-25 is the Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness
